summary: pcaversaccio 从自己的 Tornado Cash 地址直接向信标链存款合约存入 69,420 ETH，示范隐私工具的正当用途。jbaylina 发文论述基于实时证明的 Rollup 同步可组合。Nero_eth 提出提前拒绝恶意 BAL 的方法。ACDT #68 表示 epbs-devnet-0 仍以 2 月底为目标。

items.topic: 隐私：Tornado Cash 的正当用途
items.title: pcaversaccio：从 Tornado Cash 地址直接向信标链存款合约存入 69,420 ETH，今后的提款与资助交易都将带有 Tornado 来源，这是正当使用的先例
items.title_en: pcaversaccio: deposited 69,420 ETH into the beacon deposit contract straight from a Tornado Cash address, so every future withdrawal and grant carries Tornado provenance, a precedent for good use

items.title: ethresear.ch：通过实时证明实现 Rollup 之间的同步可组合
items.note: （jbaylina）14:55：基于 Rollup 无特权排序器，任何人都可提议区块，配合实时证明可在同一槽内跨 Rollup 组合调用。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Synchronous Composability Between Rollups via Realtime Proving
items.note_en: (jbaylina), 14:55: based rollups have no privileged sequencer, so anyone can propose blocks, and with realtime proving calls can compose across rollups within one slot.

items.title: ethresear.ch：提前拒绝恶意 BAL
items.note: （Nero_eth）13:23：EIP-7928 要求 builder 声明区块执行访问的全部状态位置，文章讨论如何在执行前识别并拒绝虚报的 BAL。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Early Rejection of Adversarial BALs
items.note_en: (Nero_eth), 13:23: EIP-7928 requires builders to declare all state locations a block touches, and the post covers spotting and rejecting false BALs before execution.
